research_questions: Do local nonclaims and ADJACENT_TRUTH != INHERITED_TRUTH improve mixed-register classification?
Can a cold consumer classify supported, contradicted, unavailable/unverified, and satirical claims without using plausibility or neighbouring truth as provenance?

paired_variants.guarded: Normal delivery with local BOUNDARY nonclaims and the adjacency/satire guard treatment retained.
paired_variants.ablated: Same delivery with only local BOUNDARY nonclaims and the tested adjacency/formalization/satire boundary treatment removed; general UNKNOWN != FALSE semantics remain.

tool-enabled.note: Harness-managed repository retrieval is the tool boundary; the oracle and expected labels are never queried.

default_local_runner.immutable_revision: resolved from the exact installed Ollama tag digest at run time

interpretation: Paired blinded guarded/ablated measurements are empirical derived evidence. A positive delta is descriptive for the exact immutable model/run; it is not universal or causal proof without replication.
